title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WS Form WS Form…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WS Form LITE versions up to and including 1.12.19. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can be executed in the context of users' browsers.
